justification: Minimal repair replaces the bare EL verb with its morphologically integrated infinitive form. The 'necesito + infinitive' frame forces the infinitive shape uniquely; no tense ambiguity.

provenance.review_disagreement: Independent blind reviewer repaired to 'Necesito checkear el correo.' -- an attested alternate integration spelling (English-orthography stem plus -ear, alongside the qu-respelled 'chequear'), not a different construction. Added as alternate_repairs.
